summary: Tested the student-results preview + notify features end to end. Backend: 7 of 8 pytest tests pass. Preview (commit=false) sorts every row into new/changed/unchanged/invalid/out_of_scope/duplicate, writes nothing to the DB (checked with a DB snapshot) and returns student_name. Changed rows include 'old'. commit=true saves only new/changed rows. When a row repeats, the last one wins (s1_gpa '81' saved). Literal values kept ('77.70', '58.30'). With notify=true exactly one db.notifications type='results' doc is created for student 1001 and notified=1, and the message includes 'أُرسل إشعار صدور النتيجة'. Re-uploading an identical file gives notified=0 and no new doc. notify=false gives none. Student 1001 sees 'صدرت نتيجتك' at GET /api/notifications/my, and /students/me/results returns literal values. Dean Salim (manage_grades added temporarily, then restored) sees 12345 (another faculty) and unregistered TEST_ reg numbers as out_of_scope with a reason; they are not saved, a file with only out-of-scope rows returns 403, and 12345 is hidden from his list. Frontend as admin: all the flows requested work (choose file, preview panel with counts and per-row badges, notify toggle on by default, cancel, new file clears preview, commit saves and refreshes the list). One failure: rows marked duplicate have no 'reason'.

minor.issue: Rows marked 'duplicate' have no 'reason' field, which the spec requires. Cause: the reason is set when an item is first appended (status new/changed/unchanged at that point). A later row with the same (reg,lvl) then flips the earlier item to 'duplicate' without setting item['reason'] = REASON_AR['duplicate']. The UI therefore shows the 'مكرر' badge without its explanation. Fix: in the `if (reg, lvl) in last:` branch, also set reason and pop 'old'.

ui_bugs.issue: No reason text shown for duplicate rows (consequence of the backend issue above)

issues: results-total briefly shows 'عدد الصفوف: 0' while the initial list is loading (cosmetic)

action_items: In _analyze, when marking an earlier row as duplicate, set its reason to REASON_AR['duplicate'] (and drop 'old')
critical_code_review_comments: _notify_students runs via asyncio.create_task without keeping a reference or logging errors. The in-app insert can fail silently, and notified is computed before the insert happens. Consider awaiting the DB insert and putting only FCM in the background.
notified uses count_documents on students. If one student_id has several student docs with user_id, a student gets several notifications. Use distinct user_id.
_analyze runs one find_one per row (N+1 queries). Fine for small files; for large ones use a single $in query.

_scope_regs: an admin can save results for reg_nos that are not registered students (status 'new', name blank). This is intentional, but the UI labels these rows '(غير مربوط بطالب)' only in the list, not in the preview.
seed_data_creation: Rows TEST_PN01, TEST_PN02, 1001/level 7 and TEST_UI203, plus the results notifications for 1001 created during the run, were all deleted afterwards. Salim's custom_permissions were restored to ['manage_fee_receipts','hr_manage_tasks','hr_manage_appraisals'] (verified). Final DB rows: 1001 levels 1,2,5 and 12345 level 1, unchanged. 12345/L1 has s1_status='x', updated by admin at 20:18, before this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_student_results_preview_notify.py -p no:xdist. The suite uses student 1001 (user_id 69a99544650b31fa86440da2) at level 7, and 12345 as the out-of-scope student for dean Salim (faculty 698e4f9297fef774e66e93a4). Student notifications endpoint: GET /api/notifications/my. Login: placeholders 'اسم المستخدم / رقم القيد / الرقم المرجعي' and 'كلمة المرور', then get_by_text('تسجيل الدخول').last.
